items.name: phase4_extractibility_and_wrapper_selection
items.gate: raw/random/trained extraction plus weekly wrapper validation and final manifest
items.evidence: The scoped TRAIN extractibility successor closed; the 2024 weekly wrapper completed 6240/6240 tasks across RAW, RANDOM_ENCODER and TRAINED_ENCODER with zero technical task failures. Warehouse readback reconciled, 20 target-specific RAW winners were chosen and the procedure was frozen without opening TEST. Winner unions are 20 EURUSD and 9 ETH features, but all 20 mean weekly skill scores are negative against the paired naive, so no trading-ready feature set is claimed. The older 6495-task parent closure is superseded for this scoped wave and must not be counted as the current queue.

items.name: selected_input_denoising_ablation
items.gate: paired RAW, causal reconstruction and latent inputs on selected features; target and naive unchanged; verified temporal support and RAW fallback
items.evidence: Four selected-feature origin-covering donors and a real TRAIN probe are retained. Three paired TRAIN-2023 weeks found reconstruction worse than RAW on the same target, rows and naive; RAW remains the mainline input. The latent arm and full acceptance gate are not complete.

items.name: architecture_controls
items.gate: matched ARCH result
items.evidence: The selected-input EURUSD Y_s_1h business adaptation completed 208/208 cells over 52 weekly 2024 validation weeks, one seed, with same-row naive and paired populations; closure d25425393ae537288b09cdeb21382cc7ea253292cc161bff0866be039ccc0b0b. ARCH-B mean MAE 0.000500321 versus ARCH-A 0.000511972 and naive 0.000492891, so no arm passes the trading eligibility gate. The first ARCH-C implementation omitted the origin; its receipts are archived and only that arm was rerun with a new architecture identity. Warehouse readback: 208 reports and 1664 metrics, lineage UNVERIFIED for retained local parquets. General E0 mechanism H2/H3, literature-model and other target/horizon controls remain open; no TEST was read.
